Edit.description: Block edits to .env and lock files
Edit.condition: if echo '{file}' | grep -qE '\.env(\..*)?$' && ! echo '{file}' | grep -q '\.env\.example$'; then exit 1; fi; if echo '{file}' | grep -qE '(pnpm-lock\.yaml|package-lock\.json|yarn\.lock)$'; then exit 1; fi

Write.description: Block writes to .env and lock files
Write.condition: if echo '{file}' | grep -qE '\.env(\..*)?$' && ! echo '{file}' | grep -q '\.env\.example$'; then exit 1; fi; if echo '{file}' | grep -qE '(pnpm-lock\.yaml|package-lock\.json|yarn\.lock)$'; then exit 1; fi
